explanation.en: When driving behind a motorcycle, allow at least a 2-second following distance so the cyclist has room to maneuver or stop in an emergency, and increase the space because motorists have difficulty judging a motorcycle's speed and distance. (Chapter XI — Trucks, Buses and Motorcycles)
explanation.zh: 在摩托车后方行驶时，至少保持2秒的跟车距离，让骑手有空间在紧急情况下机动或停车；并应加大空间，因为驾驶员难以判断摩托车的速度和距离。（第十一章——卡车、公共汽车和摩托车）

source.section: Chapter XI — Trucks, Buses and Motorcycles

q.en: How must you pass a motorcycle on a two-lane road?
q.zh: 在双车道道路上应如何超越摩托车？

en: Crowd into the same lane briefly — motorcycles are small
Pass on the right shoulder
Honk continuously while alongside
Allow the motorcycle a full lane; never crowd into its lane, and do not return to your lane too soon, which can force the rider to swerve right into traffic or off the road
zh: 短暂挤进同一车道——摩托车体积小
从右侧路肩通过
并行时持续鸣笛
给摩托车留出整条车道；绝不挤进它的车道，也不要过早返回你的车道，那会迫使骑手向右猛拐进入车流或驶离道路

explanation.en: When passing a motorcycle, allow a full lane to the motorcycle and never crowd into the same lane. Returning to the original lane too soon can force a rider to swerve to the right into traffic or off the road. (Chapter XI — Trucks, Buses and Motorcycles)
explanation.zh: 超越摩托车时，应给它留出整条车道，绝不挤进同一车道。过早返回原车道会迫使骑手向右猛拐，进入车流或驶离道路。（第十一章——卡车、公共汽车和摩托车）

source.section: Chapter XI — Trucks, Buses and Motorcycles

q.en: A person with a white cane is stepping into the roadway mid-block while your light is green. What must you do?
q.zh: 一名手持白色手杖的人在街区中间走上道路，而你的信号灯是绿灯。你必须怎么做？

en: Proceed — the green light gives you the right-of-way
Stop for the blind person regardless of the traffic signal indication or traffic situation
Honk and pass slowly behind them
Yield only if they are in a marked crosswalk
zh: 通行——绿灯赋予你路权
无论交通信号或交通状况如何，都必须为这名盲人停车
鸣笛后从其身后缓慢通过
只有当他们在标示的人行横道内时才让行

explanation.en: Stop for all blind persons in the roadway — identified by a white cane or a guide dog — regardless of the traffic signal indication or traffic situation. (Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety)
explanation.zh: 对所有在道路上的盲人——以白手杖或导盲犬为标识——无论交通信号显示或交通状况如何，都必须停车。（第十二章——行人安全）

source.section: Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety

q.en: The SUV ahead of you has stopped mid-block and you suspect a pedestrian is crossing in front of it. Passing that stopped vehicle is:
q.zh: 你前方的SUV停在了街区中间，你怀疑有行人在它前面过街。超越这辆停着的车：

en: Allowed if you slow to 10 mph
Allowed if you can see over the SUV
Required to keep traffic moving
Prohibited by law — never pass a vehicle stopped to allow a pedestrian to cross the street
zh: 减速至10英里/小时就可以
如果你能越过SUV看到前方就可以
为保持交通顺畅必须这样做
法律禁止——绝不能超越为让行人过街而停下的车辆

explanation.en: Never pass a vehicle stopped to allow a pedestrian to cross the street — it is prohibited by law. It is likewise prohibited to drive through a pedestrian safety zone. (Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety)
explanation.zh: 绝不能超越为让行人过街而停下的车辆——这是法律禁止的。同样，禁止驶过行人安全区。（第十二章——行人安全）

source.section: Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety

q.en: Near a school at dismissal time, a crossing guard steps out and signals you to stop even though your light is green. What must you do?
q.zh: 放学时分在一所学校附近，一名过街护导员走出并示意你停车，尽管你的灯是绿灯。你必须怎么做？

en: Obey the green light — guards are advisory only
Stop only if children are already in your lane
Stop upon the signal of any school crossing guard, and be especially watchful for children near schools, parks, playgrounds and residential areas
Slow to half speed and continue
zh: 服从绿灯——护导员只是建议性质
只有当儿童已进入你的车道时才停车
在任何学校过街护导员发出信号时停车，并在学校、公园、游乐场和住宅区附近格外留意儿童
减速到一半并继续行驶

explanation.en: Be especially watchful for children near schools, parks, playgrounds and in residential areas, and stop upon the signal of any school crossing guard. (Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety)
explanation.zh: 在学校、公园、游乐场和住宅区附近要格外留意儿童，并在任何学校过街护导员发出信号时停车。（第十二章——行人安全）

source.section: Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety

q.en: A school bus in the lane next to yours stops and its alternating red lamps start flashing. What must you do, and what is the stated cost of failing to comply?
q.zh: 你旁边车道的一辆校车停下，其交替闪烁的红灯开始闪烁。你必须怎么做？不遵守的代价是什么？

en: Slow down and pass carefully; there is no fine
Stop only if children are visible; fine is $50
Stop before reaching the bus and stay stopped until it resumes motion or the red lamps are turned off; failure to comply can cost you $1,000
Stop only when travelling in the same direction as the bus
zh: 减速并小心通过；没有罚款
只有看得见儿童时才停车；罚款50美元
在到达校车之前停车，并保持停车直到校车重新行驶或红灯熄灭；不遵守可能被罚1,000美元
只有与校车同向行驶时才停车

explanation.en: When a school bus is stopped with alternating red signal lamps flashing, drivers in the bus's lane and all lanes adjacent to it must stop before reaching the bus and not proceed until the bus resumes motion or the flashing red lamps are turned off. Failure to comply with §291C-95, HRS, can cost you $1,000. (Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety)
explanation.zh: 当校车停下并闪烁交替红灯时，校车所在车道及所有相邻车道的驾驶员必须在到达校车之前停车，直到校车重新行驶或红灯熄灭后才能继续。不遵守《夏威夷修订法规》第291C-95条可能被罚1,000美元。（第十二章——行人安全）

source.section: Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety

q.en: That same school bus is stopped on the far side of a divided highway while you travel in the opposite direction. Are you required to stop?
q.zh: 同一辆校车停在一条分隔式公路的对面，而你正对向行驶。你需要停车吗？

en: Yes — all traffic in both directions must always stop
Yes, but only until the bus doors close
Only if the median is narrower than a car length
No — vehicles proceeding in the opposite direction on a divided highway are not required to stop
zh: 需要——双向所有车辆必须始终停车
需要，但只需停到校车门关闭为止
只有当中央分隔带窄于一辆车长时才需要
不需要——在分隔式公路上对向行驶的车辆无需停车

explanation.en: Vehicles proceeding in the opposite direction on a divided highway are not required to stop for a school bus. A divided highway is two roadways separated by a strip of land or other space not intended for vehicular travel. (Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety)
explanation.zh: 在分隔式公路上对向行驶的车辆无需为校车停车。分隔式公路是指由一条不供车辆通行的土地带或其他空间隔开的两条道路。（第十二章——行人安全）

source.section: Chapter XII — Pedestrian Safety

q.en: You are passing a bicyclist on a two-lane road. How much space should you keep between your vehicle and the bicyclist?
q.zh: 你在双车道道路上超越一名骑自行车的人。你的车与自行车之间应保持多少空间？

en: As little as possible, to stay in your lane
Exactly one foot
Space is only required at night
At least 3 feet of space until you have safely passed
zh: 越少越好，以便留在你的车道内
正好一英尺
只有夜间才要求留空间
至少3英尺，直到安全通过为止

explanation.en: Motorists should maintain at least 3 feet of space between the bicyclist and their vehicle until they have safely passed. (Chapter XIII — Bicycle Safety)
explanation.zh: 驾驶员应保持其车辆与自行车之间至少3英尺的空间，直到安全通过为止。（第十三章——自行车安全）

source.section: Chapter XIII — Bicycle Safety

q.en: A bicyclist is riding in the bike lane ahead and you need to turn right at the next intersection. What is the safest approach?
q.zh: 一名骑自行车的人在你前方的自行车道内行驶，你需要在下个路口右转。最安全的做法是什么？

en: Pass the bicyclist quickly, then turn right immediately in front of them
Honk so the bicyclist moves onto the sidewalk
Turn from the left lane across the bike lane
Stay clear of the bike lane, look for and yield to bicyclists when crossing it; if you plan an immediate right turn, it is better not to pass the bicyclist first
zh: 快速超过自行车，然后立即在他们前面右转
鸣笛让骑车人上人行道
从左车道横过自行车道转弯
避开自行车道，在穿越自行车道时注意并让行骑车人；如果你打算立即右转，最好不要先超过骑车人

explanation.en: Remain clear of bike lanes, especially when making a right turn at an intersection, and look for and yield to bicyclists when crossing a bike lane. If you plan to make an immediate right turn, it is better not to pass the bicyclist. (Chapter XIII — Bicycle Safety)
explanation.zh: 保持避开自行车道，尤其在路口右转时；穿越自行车道时要注意并让行骑车人。如果你打算立即右转，最好不要先超过骑车人。（第十三章——自行车安全）

source.section: Chapter XIII — Bicycle Safety

q.en: You are parked at the curb and about to open your door next to a lane where bicyclists ride. Opening the door carelessly is:
q.zh: 你停在路边，正要打开靠近骑车人车道一侧的车门。不小心开门：

en: Only a problem if a bicyclist is actually hit
Always legal when parked legally
A traffic violation if it creates a hazard for moving traffic, including bicyclists — look before you open your door
Governed by parking rules, not traffic rules
zh: 只有真撞到骑车人才是问题
只要停车合法就永远合法
如果给包括骑车人在内的行驶交通造成危险，就是交通违法——开门前先观察
受停车规则而非交通规则管辖

explanation.en: It is a traffic violation to open a car door unexpectedly so as to create a hazard for moving traffic, including bicyclists. Look before you open your car door. (Chapter XIII — Bicycle Safety)
explanation.zh: 出乎意料地打开车门、给包括骑车人在内的行驶交通造成危险，是交通违法行为。打开车门前先观察。（第十三章——自行车安全）

source.section: Chapter XIII — Bicycle Safety

q.en: A test shows a driver's blood alcohol content (BAC) is exactly 0.08 percent. Under Hawaii law as stated in the manual, that driver is considered:
q.zh: 检测显示一名驾驶员的血液酒精含量（BAC）正好为0.08%。根据手册所述的夏威夷法律，该驾驶员被视为：

en: Only impaired, not under the influence
Under the influence of alcohol — 0.08 percent or more is the threshold
Legal to drive if they feel fine
In violation only if under 21
zh: 只是受损，还不算酒后驾驶
属于酒后驾驶——0.08%或以上是界限
如果自我感觉良好就可以开车
只有21岁以下才违法

explanation.en: A driver with a blood alcohol content of 0.08 percent or more is considered under the influence of alcohol. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 血液酒精含量达到0.08%或以上的驾驶员被视为酒后驾驶。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: A driver's BAC measures 0.06 percent. How does the manual classify that driver?
q.zh: 一名驾驶员的BAC测得为0.06%。手册如何界定该驾驶员？

en: Impaired — more than 0.05 percent but less than 0.08 percent
Sober by definition
Under the influence
In violation of zero tolerance at any age
zh: 按定义是清醒的
酒后驾驶
在任何年龄都违反零容忍

explanation.en: When a test shows alcohol in the blood, the driver may be considered impaired if the BAC is more than 0.05 percent but less than 0.08 percent, and under the influence at 0.08 percent or more. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 当检测显示血液中含有酒精时，BAC高于0.05%但低于0.08%的驾驶员可被视为受损；达到0.08%或以上则为酒后驾驶。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: For drivers under 21, Hawaii's zero tolerance rule prohibits driving with a BAC of:
q.zh: 对21岁以下驾驶员，夏威夷的零容忍规则禁止在BAC达到多少时驾驶？

en: 0.08 or more, same as adults
Any amount above 0.05
0.02 or more
Zero tolerance applies only after a first conviction
zh: 0.08或以上，与成年人相同
任何高于0.05的数值
0.02或以上
零容忍只在第一次定罪后适用

explanation.en: Zero tolerance: drivers under 21 are prohibited from operating a motor vehicle with a blood alcohol content of 0.02 or more. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 零容忍：21岁以下驾驶员禁止在血液酒精含量达到0.02或以上时驾驶机动车。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: What does "implied consent" mean for anyone driving on Hawaii's public highways?
q.zh: 对在夏威夷公共公路上驾驶的任何人来说，“默示同意”意味着什么？

en: You consent to police searches of your vehicle at any time
By operating a motor vehicle on the public highways, you are deemed to have given your consent to be tested to determine the amount of alcohol in your blood
You consent to have your license renewed automatically
You agree to attend traffic school if stopped
zh: 你同意警方随时搜查你的车辆
只要你在公共公路上驾驶机动车，就视为你已同意接受检测，以确定你血液中的酒精含量
你同意驾照自动续期
你同意被拦下时参加交通学校

explanation.en: Implied consent: any person who operates a motor vehicle on the public highways in Hawaii is deemed to have given his or her consent to be tested to determine the amount of alcohol in his or her blood. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 默示同意：任何在夏威夷公共公路上驾驶机动车的人，都被视为已同意接受检测，以确定其血液中的酒精含量。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: A driver's test comes back at 0.09 BAC. Under the administrative revocation procedure, what happens on the spot?
q.zh: 一名驾驶员的检测结果为0.09 BAC。根据行政吊销程序，当场会发生什么？

en: The license is taken away and the driver is given a 30-day temporary driving permit (the driver may request a hearing)
Nothing until a court conviction
The vehicle is impounded for 30 days
The driver is fined and keeps the license
zh: 驾照被收走，驾驶员获得一张30天的临时驾驶许可（驾驶员可申请听证）
在法院定罪前什么都不会发生
车辆被扣押30天
驾驶员被罚款并保留驾照

explanation.en: Under administrative license revocation, your license will be taken away and you will be given a 30-day temporary driving permit if a test shows a BAC of 0.08 or more — or if you refuse the test. Anyone whose license is revoked may request a hearing. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 根据行政吊销驾照程序，如果检测显示BAC达到0.08或以上——或驾驶员拒绝检测——驾照将被收走，并发给一张30天的临时驾驶许可。驾照被吊销者可申请听证。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: An officer who believes you are under the influence asks you to take a test, and you refuse. On top of possibly being charged with DUI anyway, refusing may result in revocation of your license for:
q.zh: 一名警员认为你处于酒精影响之下并要求你接受检测，你拒绝了。除了仍可能被控酒驾外，拒绝检测可能导致你的驾照被吊销多长时间？

en: 30 days in every case
Six months for a first refusal, with no further increase
No revocation is possible for a refusal
One year, two years or four years, depending on your prior alcohol enforcement contacts
zh: 任何情况下都是30天
首次拒绝六个月，且不再增加
拒绝不可能导致吊销
一年、两年或四年，取决于你以往的酒精执法记录

explanation.en: Refusal to take the test may result in revocation of your license for one year, two years or four years depending on the driver's prior alcohol enforcement contacts. In addition, the driver may be charged with driving under the influence even though he refuses the test. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 拒绝接受检测可能导致驾照被吊销一年、两年或四年，取决于驾驶员以往的酒精执法记录。此外，即使拒绝检测，驾驶员仍可能被控酒后驾驶。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: Your friend insists that refusing the alcohol test protects him, because with no test result he cannot be charged. What does the manual say?
q.zh: 你的朋友坚称拒绝酒精检测可以保护他，因为没有检测结果就不能指控他。手册怎么说？

en: He is right — no test, no charge
He is wrong — he may be charged with driving under the influence even though he refuses; the test can also prove a driver is NOT under the influence
Refusal charges apply only to commercial drivers
The officer must obtain a court order before any charge
zh: 他是对的——没检测就没指控
他错了——即使拒绝检测，他仍可能被控酒后驾驶；而且检测也可以证明驾驶员并未酒后驾驶
拒绝的指控只适用于商业驾驶员
警员必须先取得法院命令才能指控

explanation.en: The driver may be charged with driving under the influence of alcohol even though he refuses the test. And the test can work in a driver's favor: it can also prove that you are not under the influence of alcohol. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 即使驾驶员拒绝检测，仍可能被控酒后驾驶。而且检测对驾驶员也有有利的一面：它也可以证明你并未酒后驾驶。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: You are a passenger riding in the front seat with an open bottle of beer on a public highway in Hawaii. What does the law say?
q.zh: 你坐在前排乘客座上，在夏威夷的一条公共公路上拿着一瓶打开的啤酒。法律怎么说？

en: Passengers may drink as long as the driver does not
Only the driver is covered by the alcohol laws
Open containers are allowed if the bottle is in a paper bag

It is against the law to consume or possess any alcoholic beverage on any public highway or public sidewalk, and storing an opened container in the driver/passenger area of a vehicle on a public road is prohibited
zh: 只要驾驶员不喝，乘客可以喝
酒精法律只适用于驾驶员
打开的容器放进纸袋就可以
在任何公共公路或公共人行道上饮用或持有任何酒精饮料都是违法的；在公共道路上，将打开的酒精容器存放在车辆驾驶员或乘客通常乘坐的区域内也被禁止

explanation.en: It is against the law to consume or possess any alcoholic beverage on any public highway or any public sidewalk. Storing an opened alcoholic beverage container in the area of a motor vehicle normally occupied by the driver or passengers is prohibited on any public road. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 在任何公共公路或公共人行道上饮用或持有任何酒精饮料都是违法的。在公共道路上，将打开的酒精容器存放在车辆驾驶员或乘客通常乘坐的区域内也被禁止。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: A new driver tells you alcohol is a stimulant because it makes him feel more awake and confident. What does the manual teach?
q.zh: 一名新手驾驶员告诉你酒精是兴奋剂，因为它让他感觉更清醒、更自信。手册是怎么教的？

en: Alcohol is a mild stimulant at low doses
The effect depends entirely on the brand
Alcohol is a depressant, not a stimulant — it slows reflexes, interferes with judgment, reduces alertness and impairs vision; feeling stimulated is only lowered inhibitions
Feeling confident means your BAC is low
zh: 酒精在低剂量时是温和的兴奋剂
效果完全取决于品牌
酒精是抑制剂，不是兴奋剂——它会减慢反应、干扰判断、降低警觉性并损害视力；感觉兴奋只是因为抑制降低，导致失去谨慎和自控
感觉自信说明你的BAC很低

explanation.en: Alcohol is a depressant, not a stimulant. It slows normal reflexes, interferes with judgment, reduces alertness and impairs vision. If you feel stimulated after drinking, it is simply because your inhibitions are lowered, causing loss of caution and self-control. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 酒精是抑制剂，不是兴奋剂。它会减慢正常反应、干扰判断、降低警觉性并损害视力。饮酒后感觉兴奋，只是因为抑制降低，导致失去谨慎和自制力。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: Two friends drink the same evening — one drinks beer, the other whiskey — and each argues the other's drink is "stronger for driving." What actually determines the problem?
q.zh: 两位朋友同一晚喝酒——一个喝啤酒，另一个喝威士忌——都说对方的酒“对驾驶更烈”。真正决定问题的是什么？

en: Beer is always safer than whiskey for driving
Whiskey affects driving only after three drinks
It doesn't matter whether you drink beer, wine, whiskey or any other alcoholic beverage — it's the amount of alcohol that enters your blood
Wine has no effect on driving
zh: 啤酒对驾驶永远比威士忌安全
威士忌只有在三杯后才影响驾驶
无论你喝啤酒、葡萄酒、威士忌还是任何其他酒精饮料都无关紧要——起作用的是进入你血液的酒精量
葡萄酒对驾驶没有影响

explanation.en: It doesn't matter whether you drink beer, wine, whiskey or any other alcoholic beverage; it's the amount of alcohol that enters your blood that causes the problem. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 无论你喝啤酒、葡萄酒、威士忌还是任何其他酒精饮料都无关紧要；起作用的是进入你血液的酒精量。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: Why does the same amount of alcohol affect a driver more rapidly when it is drunk on an empty stomach?
q.zh: 为什么同样量的酒精在空腹时对驾驶员起作用更快？

en: An empty stomach increases the legal BAC limit
Food in the stomach slows how fast the alcohol affects you; on an empty stomach a small amount affects you more rapidly than after a recent meal
Alcohol evaporates faster on an empty stomach
It doesn't — the stomach makes no difference
zh: 空腹会提高法定BAC上限
胃里的食物会减慢酒精起作用的速度；空腹时少量酒精比刚吃过饭后起作用更快
酒精在空腹时蒸发更快
不会——胃里有没有食物没有区别

explanation.en: Alcohol can affect you differently at different times. A small amount on an empty stomach will affect you more rapidly than it would if you had recently eaten a meal. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 酒精在不同时候对你的影响不同。空腹时少量酒精起作用的速度，比刚吃过饭后要快。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: After several drinks, a driver drinks black coffee, eats a meal and takes a cold shower, and now feels ready to drive. Under the manual, what is his actual condition?
q.zh: 喝了几杯后，一名驾驶员喝了黑咖啡、吃了一顿饭、又冲了冷水澡，现在觉得可以开车了。根据手册，他的实际状态是？

en: Sober, because he feels awake
Still under the influence — coffee, food or a cold shower might wake you up, but they will not sober you up; only time lets the liver burn the alcohol off
Legal to drive if he passes a field sobriety test from a friend
Sober after exactly one hour regardless of intake
zh: 清醒了，因为他感觉醒了
仍处于酒精影响之下——咖啡、食物或冷水澡可能让你清醒一点，但不会让你酒醒；只有时间能让肝脏把酒精代谢掉
如果通过了朋友做的现场清醒测试就可以开车
无论喝多少，正好一小时后就清醒

explanation.en: Once alcohol enters your blood there is nothing you can do to lessen the effect. Black coffee, food or a cold shower might wake you up, but they will not sober you up. Alcohol is burned up by the liver and eliminated through the kidneys and lungs; the process takes time. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 酒精一旦进入血液，没有任何办法减轻其作用。黑咖啡、食物或冷水澡可能让你清醒一点，但不会让你酒醒。酒精由肝脏代谢，经肾脏和肺排出体外；这个过程需要时间。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: Before taking a new prescription medicine, and also when using common over-the-counter remedies, what should a driver do about driving effects?
q.zh: 在服用新的处方药时，以及使用常见非处方药时，驾驶员应就驾驶影响做些什么？

en: Nothing — medicines are never a driving issue
Ask your doctor about any possible effects of a medicine on your driving ability; some allergy remedies and cold pills you can buy without a prescription can also affect your driving
Only illegal drugs affect driving
Stop all medication before any trip
zh: 什么都不用做——药物从来不是驾驶问题
向医生咨询药物对驾驶能力可能产生的影响；一些无需处方购买的抗过敏药和感冒药也可能影响驾驶能力
只有非法药物才影响驾驶
任何出行前停用所有药物

explanation.en: Before taking medicine, ask your doctor about any possible effects which might relate to your driving ability. Some allergy remedies and cold pills sold without a prescription may contain ingredients which can affect your driving ability. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 服用药物前，应向医生咨询其对驾驶能力可能产生的影响。一些无需处方即可购买的抗过敏药和感冒药可能含有影响驾驶能力的成分。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: A driver takes a prescribed sedative and then has two drinks, reasoning that each alone is a small amount. Why is that reasoning dangerous?
q.zh: 一名驾驶员服用了处方镇静剂，然后又喝了两杯，认为每样单独量都很小。为什么这种想法危险？

en: Sedatives cancel out alcohol
Two drinks neutralize any prescription drug
The danger is only from the sedative, not the drinks
The combination of alcohol and drugs can have a much more pronounced effect than either taken separately — never mix alcohol and drugs
zh: 镇静剂会抵消酒精
两杯酒会中和任何处方药
危险只来自镇静剂，与酒无关
酒精与药物混合的作用可能比单独使用任何一种都强得多——绝不要将酒精与药物混合

explanation.en: The combination of alcohol and drugs can, in some cases, have a much more pronounced effect than either taken separately. Never mix alcohol and drugs. (Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs)
explanation.zh: 在某些情况下，酒精与药物混合的作用比单独使用任何一种都强得多。绝不要将酒精与药物混合。（第九章——酒精与其他药物）

source.section: Chapter IX — Alcohol and Other Drugs

q.en: What is the minimum age to be eligible for a Hawaii instruction permit?
q.zh: 获得夏威夷学习许可（instruction permit）的最低年龄是多少？

en: 15 years
16 years
16½ years
15½ years
zh: 16岁半
15岁半

explanation.en: You must be at least 15½ years of age to be eligible for an instruction permit. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 必须年满15岁半才有资格获得学习许可。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: Driving on an instruction permit, who must accompany you, and where must that person sit (in a car)?
q.zh: 持学习许可驾驶时，谁必须陪同你？（在小汽车内）该人必须坐在哪里？

en: Any licensed driver, anywhere in the car
A driver at least 21 years old who is licensed for that type of vehicle, sitting in the right front seat
A parent, in the back seat
Any passenger over 18, in the right front seat
zh: 任何持证驾驶员，车内任何位置
年满21岁、持有该类车辆驾照的驾驶员，坐在右前座
父母，坐在后座
任何18岁以上的乘客，坐在右前座

explanation.en: An instruction permit allows you to drive when supervised by a driver at least 21 years of age who is licensed to drive that type of vehicle. In all vehicles except motorcycles, the licensed driver must sit in the right front seat. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 持学习许可驾驶时，必须由年满21岁、持有该类车辆驾照的驾驶员监督。除摩托车外，在所有车辆中，该持证驾驶员必须坐在右前座。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: On an instruction permit, you may drive between 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. only when accompanied by:
q.zh: 持学习许可，在晚上11点到凌晨5点之间驾驶时，必须由谁陪同？

en: Any licensed driver aged 21 or older
A licensed driver education instructor
No one — permit driving is banned in those hours
Your parent or guardian
zh: 任何年满21岁的持证驾驶员
持证的驾驶教育教练
任何人都不行——该时段禁止持许可驾驶
你的父母或监护人

explanation.en: With an instruction permit you may drive only when accompanied by a licensed driver at least 21 years of age; if it is between 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m., you must be accompanied by your parent or guardian. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 持学习许可驾驶时，必须由年满21岁的持证驾驶员陪同；在晚上11点至凌晨5点之间，必须由父母或监护人陪同。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: How long must you hold a valid instruction permit before you can apply for a provisional license?
q.zh: 在申请临时驾照（provisional license）之前，必须持有有效的学习许可多长时间？

en: 90 days
6 months and one day
One year
180 days
zh: 6个月零一天
一年

explanation.en: You must hold a valid instruction permit for a period of 180 days before applying for a provisional license. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 在申请临时驾照之前，必须持有有效的学习许可满180天。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: To obtain a provisional license at the minimum age of 16, which requirements must be met?
q.zh: 要在最低年龄16岁获得临时驾照，必须满足哪些要求？

en: Only passing the written test again
Completing a state-certified driver's education course with classroom and behind-the-wheel certificates, and passing a road test
Holding a permit for one year and logging 100 hours
A parent must hold a Hawaii license for five years
zh: 只需再次通过笔试
完成州认证的驾驶教育课程并持有课堂和实车证书，并通过路考
持有许可一年并记录100小时
父母必须持有夏威夷驾照满五年

explanation.en: The minimum age for a provisional license is 16 years. You must complete a state-certified driver's education course and possess the classroom and behind-the-wheel certificates, and you must pass a road test. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 临时驾照的最低年龄是16岁。你必须完成州认证的驾驶教育课程并持有课堂和实车证书，并且必须通过路考。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: On a provisional license, how many passengers under 18 who are not household members may you transport?
q.zh: 持临时驾照时，可以搭载多少名非家庭成员的18岁以下乘客？

en: Only one person under 18 who is not a household member
None at all
Up to three, if they wear belts
There is no limit
zh: 只能搭载一名非家庭成员的18岁以下人士
完全不能搭载
最多三名，只要他们系安全带
没有限制

explanation.en: Your provisional license allows you to transport only one person under age 18 who is not a household member. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 你的临时驾照只允许搭载一名非家庭成员的18岁以下人士。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: On a provisional license, driving between 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. is allowed without a parent or guardian only in which cases?
q.zh: 持临时驾照，在晚上11点至凌晨5点之间，只有在哪些情况下可以在没有父母或监护人陪同的情况下驾驶？

en: When driving anywhere within your home county
When driving to and from employment, or to and from a school-authorized activity
When at least two passengers are present
It is never allowed
zh: 在本县内任何地方驾驶时
上下班途中，或往返学校批准的活动时
至少有两名乘客时
永远不允许

explanation.en: With a provisional license you may drive between 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. only when accompanied by a licensed parent or guardian — unless driving to and from employment or driving to and from the driver's school-authorized activity. During those hours you also may not transport more than one person under 18 unless accompanied by your parent or guardian. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 持临时驾照，在晚上11点至凌晨5点之间只有在持证父母或监护人陪同时才能驾驶——除非是上下班途中，或往返学校批准的活动。在这些时段内，除非有父母或监护人陪同，也不得搭载超过一名18岁以下人士。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: After getting a provisional license at 16, when do you become eligible for a full Class 3 driver's license?
q.zh: 16岁获得临时驾照后，什么时候才有资格获得正式的3类驾照？

en: Immediately after passing a second written test
At age 18 in all cases
After one full year on the provisional license
After holding the provisional license for six months — and the minimum age for a Class 3 license is 17 years
zh: 通过第二次笔试后立即可以
所有情况都要到18岁
在临时驾照满一整年之后
持有临时驾照满六个月后——且3类驾照的最低年龄是17岁

explanation.en: You must hold a provisional license for six months before applying for a driver's license, and to get a Class 3 license you must be at least 17 years old. Drivers under 18 follow the graduated licensing program. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 在申请正式驾照之前必须持有临时驾照满六个月，且获得3类驾照必须年满17岁。18岁以下驾驶员遵循分级驾照计划。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: Which license class covers mopeds, and what testing does it require?
q.zh: 哪一类驾照涵盖轻便摩托车（moped）？它需要什么考试？

en: Class 3; the regular car tests
Class 2; a special knowledge test only
No license is needed for a moped
Class 1; a special knowledge test and an off-street skills test
zh: 第3类；普通汽车考试
第2类；只需专项知识考试
轻便摩托车不需要驾照
第1类；专项知识考试和场内技能考试

explanation.en: A Class 1 license covers mopeds, and a Class 2 license covers motorcycles and motor scooters. Each requires a special knowledge test and an off-street skills test. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 第1类驾照涵盖轻便摩托车，第2类涵盖摩托车和机动踏板车。两者都需要专项知识考试和场内技能考试。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: A standard Class 3 driver's license authorizes you to drive:
q.zh: 标准3类驾照授权你驾驶：

en: Any vehicle up to 26,000 pounds GVWR
Only passenger cars under 10,000 pounds
Any vehicle except motorcycles
Any single vehicle with a GVWR of 18,000 pounds or less, and vehicles designed to transport 15 or fewer passengers including the driver
zh: 任何GVWR不超过26,000磅的车辆
只有10,000磅以下的乘用车
除摩托车外的任何车辆
任何GVWR为18,000磅或以下的单辆车辆，以及设计载客15人或以下（包括驾驶员）的车辆

explanation.en: Class 3 covers any single vehicle with a GVWR of 18,000 pounds or less, and vehicles designed to transport 15 or fewer passengers including the driver. Class 4 covers single vehicles of 18,001 to 26,000 pounds. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 第3类涵盖任何GVWR为18,000磅或以下的单辆车辆，以及设计载客15人或以下（包括驾驶员）的车辆。第4类涵盖GVWR为18,001至26,000磅的单辆车辆。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: A Class A commercial driver's license (CDL) is required for:
q.zh: A类商业驾照（CDL）适用于：

en: A combination of vehicles with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more, where the towed vehicle's GVWR is in excess of 10,000 pounds
Any vehicle with air brakes
Any vehicle carrying 10 or more passengers
Single vehicles of 18,001 to 26,000 pounds
zh: GVWR为26,001磅或以上的组合车辆，且被牵引车辆的GVWR超过10,000磅
任何带气压刹车的车辆
任何载客10人或以上的车辆
GVWR为18,001至26,000磅的单辆车辆

explanation.en: Class A (CDL) covers any combination of vehicles with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more, with the GVWR of the towed vehicle in excess of 10,000 pounds. Class B covers single vehicles of 26,001 pounds or more with a towed unit not over 10,000 pounds; Class C covers vehicles designed for 16 or more passengers or hauling placarded hazardous materials. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: A类（CDL）涵盖GVWR为26,001磅或以上的组合车辆，且被牵引车辆的GVWR超过10,000磅。B类涵盖GVWR为26,001磅或以上的单辆车辆（被牵引部分不超过10,000磅）；C类涵盖设计载客16人或以上、或运输需挂标牌危险品的车辆。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: Before applying for any of the larger-class (Category 4 / commercial-type) licenses, an applicant must be at least:
q.zh: 申请任何较大型类别（第4类/商业型）驾照之前，申请人必须至少年满：

en: 21 years old
18 years old
25 years old
17 years old with parental consent
zh: 17岁并有父母同意

explanation.en: You must be at least 21 years old before applying for any of the larger class licenses; each class or endorsement requires special tests. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 申请任何较大型类别驾照之前必须年满21岁；每个类别或签注都需要专项考试。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: Your Hawaii driver's license expires next month. Which renewal statements are correct?
q.zh: 你的夏威夷驾照下个月到期。关于续期的说法哪项正确？

en: You may renew within six months before the expiration date, and there is a 90-day grace period after expiry
Renewal is only possible after the license expires

Your license can be renewed within six months before the expiration date; every Hawaii license is void after the expiration date — there is no grace period — though renewal is still possible within one year after expiration
An expired license remains valid for two years
zh: 可以在到期前六个月内续期，到期后有90天宽限期
只有在驾照过期后才能续期
可以在到期前六个月内续期；夏威夷驾照在到期日后即失效——没有宽限期——但到期后一年内仍可续期
过期驾照在两年内仍然有效

explanation.en: You may renew your license within six months before the expiration date. Every Hawaii State driver's license is void after the expiration date; there is no grace period. Your license may be renewed within a year after the expiration date; after that, you must follow the procedure for an original license. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 你可以在到期前六个月内续期。夏威夷州驾照在到期日后即失效；没有宽限期。到期后一年内仍可续期；超过该期限，必须按首次申领程序办理。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: What must you do at every license renewal, and what is the limit on renewing by mail?
q.zh: 每次续期驾照时必须做什么？邮寄续期有什么限制？

en: Pay a road test fee; mail renewal is unlimited
Retake the written test; mail renewal is never allowed
Pass a vision test before renewal; you may renew by mail once, but must appear in person at every other renewal
Nothing — renewal is automatic with registration
zh: 缴纳路考费；邮寄续期次数不限
重考笔试；从不允许邮寄续期
续期前必须通过视力检查；可以邮寄续期一次，但每隔一次续期必须本人到场
什么都不用做——随车辆登记自动续期

explanation.en: Before your license is renewed, you must pass a vision test. You may renew your license once by mail, but you must present yourself before the examiner of drivers every other renewal. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 续期前必须通过视力检查。你可以邮寄续期一次，但每隔一次续期必须亲自到驾驶员考官面前办理。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: For a REAL ID compliant license or permit, how many documents proving your principal residence address in Hawaii are required?
q.zh: 申请符合REAL ID标准的驾照或许可时，需要提供几份证明你在夏威夷主要居住地址的文件？

en: One document
Three documents
Residence proof is not required for a permit
Two documents, each showing your name and principal residence address in Hawaii
zh: 一份文件
三份文件
许可不需要居住证明
两份文件，每份都显示你的姓名和在夏威夷的主要居住地址

explanation.en: Applicants must provide documents proving legal name, date of birth, legal presence in the USA, and Social Security number, plus two forms of proof of principal residence address in the State of Hawaii — for example a current utility bill, telephone bill, bank statement or medical statement. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 申请人必须提供证明法定姓名、出生日期、在美国合法居留和社会安全号码的文件，以及两份在夏威夷州主要居住地址的证明——例如当前的水电费账单、电话账单、银行对账单或医疗账单。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: An applicant cannot provide a Social Security number. What credential is available to them?
q.zh: 一名申请人无法提供社会安全号码。他们可以获得什么证件？

en: No license of any kind
A limited purpose driver's license — valid for driving only, and not acceptable as identification for federal purposes such as boarding an airplane
A full REAL ID license without the number
A permit that must be renewed every 30 days
zh: 任何驾照都不能获得
有限用途驾照——仅可用于驾驶，不能作为联邦用途的身份证明，例如不能用于登机
无需号码的完整REAL ID驾照
必须每30天续期一次的许可

explanation.en: Drivers who choose not to provide, or are unable to provide, a Social Security number may obtain a limited purpose driver's license. It is valid for driving only and is not an acceptable identification document for federal purposes, such as boarding an airplane. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 选择不提供或无法提供社会安全号码的驾驶员可以获得有限用途驾照。它仅可用于驾驶，不能作为联邦用途的身份证明文件，例如不能用于登机。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: You hold a driver's license from a foreign country that is party to the compact, together with an International Driving Permit issued there. How long is it valid in Hawaii after your entry into the USA?
q.zh: 你持有一本来自缔约国的外国驾照，以及在该国签发的国际驾驶许可。它在入境美国后在夏威夷有效多长时间？

en: 30 days
Six months
One year after the date of entry into the USA
It is never valid in Hawaii
zh: 六个月
入境美国之日起一年
在夏威夷从不有效

explanation.en: Compact foreign drivers' licenses accompanied by an International Driving Permit issued in the foreign jurisdiction are valid for one year after the date of entry into the USA (counted from your first port of entry). (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 缔约国驾照附带在该司法管辖区签发的国际驾驶许可的，在入境美国之日起一年内有效（自你首次入境口岸起算）。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: For your road (performance) test, which vehicle and document conditions apply?
q.zh: 参加路考（实车考试）时，车辆和文件方面适用哪些条件？

en: Any borrowed vehicle is fine, documents are checked later
The testing station provides the vehicle and insurance

You must be accompanied by a licensed driver and provide a vehicle in safe operating condition with current registration, a current safety inspection certificate and an insurance identification card; all safety defects must be corrected before the test, and passengers are not permitted during the test
Only the registration document is required
zh: 任何借来的车都可以，文件之后再查
考场提供车辆和保险
必须由持证驾驶员陪同，并提供一辆运行安全的车辆，带有效的登记、有效的安全检验合格证和保险识别卡；所有安全缺陷必须在考试前修复，考试期间不允许有乘客
只需登记文件

explanation.en: You must be accompanied to the testing station by a licensed driver and provide a vehicle in safe operating condition with a current registration, current safety inspection certificate and insurance identification card. All vehicle safety defects must be corrected prior to the test, and passengers are not permitted during the test. (Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers)
explanation.zh: 你必须由持证驾驶员陪同到考场，并提供一辆运行安全的车辆，带有效的登记、有效的安全检验合格证和保险识别卡。所有车辆安全缺陷必须在考试前修复，考试期间不允许有乘客。（第一章——驾驶员驾照）

source.section: Chapter I — Licensing of Drivers

q.en: What are the minimum mandatory liability coverages under Hawaii's motor vehicle insurance law, as stated in the manual?
q.zh: 根据手册，夏威夷机动车保险法规定的最低强制责任险保额是多少？

en: $10,000 per person / $10,000 per accident bodily injury; $5,000 property damage
$20,000 per person with an aggregate limit of $40,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $10,000 for property damage per accident
Liability coverage is optional in Hawaii
zh: 人身伤害每人10,000美元/每起事故10,000美元；财产损失5,000美元
人身伤害每人20,000美元、每起事故总额上限40,000美元；财产损失每起事故10,000美元
夏威夷的责任险是可选的

explanation.en: The basic benefits include up to $10,000 per person for medical and rehabilitative expenses. Liability coverage is $20,000 per person with an aggregate limit of $40,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $10,000 for property damage per accident. Damage to your own car is not covered unless you carry additional coverage. (Chapter VIII — No Fault Insurance / Financial Responsibility)
explanation.zh: 基本保障包括每人最高10,000美元的医疗和康复费用。责任险为人身伤害每人20,000美元、每起事故总额上限40,000美元；财产损失每起事故10,000美元。除非你另行投保，否则自己车辆的损坏不在保障范围内。（第八章——无过错保险/财务责任）

source.section: Chapter VIII — No Fault Insurance / Financial Responsibility

q.en: After a conviction for certain offenses involving vehicles, how long must you file and maintain proof of financial responsibility (Form SR-22)?
q.zh: 因某些涉及车辆的违法行为被定罪后，必须提交并维持财务责任证明（SR-22表）多长时间？

en: Three years from the conviction date
One year from the conviction date
Until the next license renewal only
Six months
zh: 自定罪之日起三年
自定罪之日起一年
只到下一次驾照续期为止
六个月

explanation.en: Upon conviction of certain offenses involving vehicles, you must file and maintain proof of financial responsibility for a period of three (3) years from the conviction date, filing evidence of insurance (Form SR-22). The penalty for non-compliance is suspension of the driver's license. (Chapter VIII — No Fault Insurance / Financial Responsibility)
explanation.zh: 因某些涉及车辆的违法行为被定罪后，必须自定罪之日起三（3）年内提交并维持财务责任证明，提交保险证明（SR-22表）。不遵守的处罚是吊销驾照。（第八章——无过错保险/财务责任）

source.section: Chapter VIII — No Fault Insurance / Financial Responsibility
